visual_enhancers.grid_borders: The Technical Look: Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse. Items have subtle right/bottom borders. Useful for timesheet data entry.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Buttons and links must explicitly set hover colors (e.g., hover:bg-gray-800 hover:text-white). Focus states must have high contrast.

hero_background.description: Modern building under construction with yellow accents. Used for the login page background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layouts and Shadcn components for complex interactions like DatePicker, Select, Forms.
Write all React code using .js extension (JSX is supported in .js files for this environment), NOT .tsx.
Include data-testid on ALL interactive and informational elements (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Implement the 3 roles: Employee, Project Manager, Admin.
Ensure timesheet allows multiple jobs per day, 30min/1hr lunch select, task codes dropdown with 'add new' functionality, running totals, and week ending date.
Implement save default from last entry functionality.
Include an audible notification mechanism for submission reminders.
Include a PDF export function for the timesheets.
Ensure strict adherence to Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast layout. Do not use soft Neumorphic shadows, stick to flat/1px borders.
Do not use heavily rounded card components where a data-dense grid or table is more suitable. Emphasize data legibility.
